question: Q-N-S2-D3
text: Card tips per card trip (card tips ÷ trip count for payment type 1) by month, 2023 vs 2024.
interpretation: Card tips per card trip (card tips / trip count for payment type 1) by calendar month, 2023 vs 2024.
assemble: SELECT calendar_month, MAX(CASE WHEN pickup_year = 2023 THEN card_tips / NULLIF(trips, 0) END) AS card_tips_per_card_trip_2023, MAX(CASE WHEN pickup_year = 2024 THEN card_tips / NULLIF(trips, 0) END) AS card_tips_per_card_trip_2024 FROM q WHERE trips > 0 GROUP BY calendar_month ORDER BY calendar_month
